elements.evidence: No most-favoured-nation obligation burdening Customer remains, so there is no duration exceeding the fallback limit.

result.reason: The redline cleanly removes the sole MFN obligation imposed on Customer and retains the unrelated protections in § 12.3. Because no Customer-burdening MFN remains, it fully achieves the preferred position and necessarily stays within the fallback's scope, duration, and comparison limits. The deletion is minimal and introduces no contradictory or unrelated terms.
